links.outcome: Reading grade level and reading ease of ChatGPT vs AAO-HNS patient information
links.effect: ChatGPT outputs were at least two reading grade levels higher than AAO-HNS material (p < 0.001) and had significantly lower reading ease scores (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Material generated from ChatGPT Output 1 and ChatGPT Output 2 were at least two reading grade levels higher than that of material from AAO-HNS (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality and readability of patient-facing information generated by ChatGPT compared to expert-authored materials, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
